name: jetbrains-gateway
description: Optional SSH server to support JetBrains Gateway / Connect to DevContainer

start_sshd.description: If true, configure and enable sshd in the container (expose port in compose)

postInstallCheck.command: sh -c 'command -v sshd >/dev/null 2>&1 || command -v ssh >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "sshd/ssh not found"'
postInstallCheck.description: Verify SSH server/client presence required for JetBrains Gateway usage
